entries.headline: Six transports, North Sea surveillance sighting and Russian aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, a surveillance aircraft near the North Sea and Russian aircraft over Europe. The post did not identify specific missions or establish a connection between the sightings.

entries.headline: Six US cargo aircraft and Russian transport jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and North America, with a Russian transport jet also tracked nearby. The post did not specify the Russian aircraft's precise location or confirm any connection between the flights.

entries.headline: Six Air Force transports and Navy surveillance aircraft over Atlantic reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, a US Navy surveillance aircraft over the Atlantic and Russian aircraft near Europe. The post did not identify their specific missions.

entries.headline: Six transports, Navy surveillance aircraft and Russian government jet reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea. It also reported sightings of a US Navy surveillance aircraft and a Russian government jet that day, without identifying their specific missions.

entries.headline: Six transports across North America and Europe reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne over North America and Europe, a Russian aircraft near US airspace and continuing surveillance aircraft activity it described as routine. The post did not establish a connection between the sightings.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of Merz visit and Ukraine drone deal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report attributed to Reuters that Merz had arrived in Ukraine to finalise a drone deal and release aid, crediting @Robertchester-j5b. The post did not specify the agreement's terms or the amount of aid.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Zelensky statement on Russian refineries
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a report attributed to Reuters that Zelensky said Ukraine would target Russian refineries in response to Moscow's new air-strike doctrine, crediting @Robertchester-j5b. The post relayed a stated intention rather than confirming a new attack.

entries.headline: Six cargo aircraft, command and surveillance sightings reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military cargo aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one over the North Sea and another in the Gulf region. It also reported a nuclear command aircraft and a surveillance aircraft; the visible post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Six transports, UK surveillance sighting and Russian aircraft near Alaska reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six large US military transport aircraft airborne over North America and the North Sea. It also reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft near the United Kingdom and Russian aircraft near Alaska, without confirming their missions or a connection between the sightings.

entries.headline: Six transports, Navy surveillance aircraft and two command jets reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea. It also reported a US Navy surveillance aircraft and two nuclear command aircraft detected that day, without identifying their specific missions.

entries.headline: US transports and command aircraft; Russian aircraft near US airspace reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States. It also reported a Russian special-purpose aircraft sighted earlier near US airspace, without identifying its precise location or linking the sightings.

entries.headline: Six transports and two earlier coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one over the North Sea. It also reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard earlier that day, without identifying the messages' content or linking them to the aircraft.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Karambakkudi
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 near Karambakkudi, India. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Navy F-35 mission-planning redesign report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that the US Navy was seeking help to redesign F-35 mission-planning software used for sortie preparation and tactical data loading. The post described a proposed redesign without confirming a completed upgrade.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Taiwan F-16C Block 70 delivery report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report that Taiwan had received its first two new-build F-16C Block 70 fighters after delays. The post relayed the report without providing independent confirmation or a delivery date.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Muzayri'

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Uruma
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 near Uruma, Japan. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: BFLO35 P-8 ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for BFLO35, described as an Australian military P-8, at Darwin, Australia. The post reported the aircraft's ground status without confirming a specific mission.

entries.headline: E-6 departure alert near Chesapeake Ranch Estates
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 TACAMO aircraft near Chesapeake Ranch Estates, United States. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares YFQ-48 first-flight report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report that Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48 Talon Blue had made its first autonomous flight, relating it to the Collaborative Combat Aircraft program. The post relayed the report without providing independent confirmation or a flight date.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Talon Blue autonomous-flight report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A Talon Blue had completed its first fully autonomous flight. Its commentary described the aircraft as a drone wingman for the US Air Force; the post did not provide independent confirmation or a flight date.
